result:
I updated `src/exports/links.ts`. `DownloadLink` now has `expiresAt: string`, set to 7 days after creation as an ISO timestamp. The URL also carries it as `&expires=<URL-encoded expiresAt>`. I didn't run or test it.

The `expires` parameter is only a value in the URL. Nothing checks it yet, so the link won't actually stop working after 7 days until the download or serving side validates it.

I also haven't looked for other places that build a `DownloadLink` object directly. If any exist, they'll need the new `expiresAt` field.
